All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**Implementation Consultant (Solventum)**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**  
As an Implementation consultant, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Collaborating with clients and Solventum team members to deploy and configure Solventum products by completing project deliverables and serving implementation needs.

* Assessing current state customer coding, CDI, and visit workflows while working within an implementation team to validate that the proposed future state fits with overall project objectives.

* Leading and working interactively with Solventum clients and Solventum team members to configure, test, and validate Solventum Revenue Cycle application environments.

* Leading issue resolution: communicating with client and internal teams on issue resolution and configuration change control by tracking and documenting issues encountered.

* Performing isolation and analysis of issues by partnering with support and escalations team for root cause analysis and troubleshooting.

* Training system administrators and end users on maintenance and administration of Solventum Products.

* Leading testing and go-live support. Interacting with customer's team on issue resolution and configuration changes.

* Keeping up to date with all new features, functions, business issues, policies, and implementation options. Contributing to the evolutionary growth of implementation infrastructure by developing and updating educational materials, documentation, tools, and programs.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:

  

Bachelor’s Degree or higher from an accredited university Minimum of (4) four years of experience with support of software and/or implementation of software (preferably in a healthcare setting supporting Solventum™ 360 Encompass™, Health Data Management (HDM) and Rule Definition Language (RDL)in a private, public, government or military environment

  

OR

  

High School Diploma/GED or higher from an accredited institution and a minimum of (8) eight years of experience in software and/or implementation of software (preferably in a healthcare setting supporting Solventum™ 360 Encompass™, Health Data Management (HDM) and Rule Definition Language (RDL)in a private, public, government or military environment

  

Minimum of two (2) combined years of working knowledge of hospital and/or professional healthcare coding workflow

  

Minimum of two (2) year' experience in a client facing implementation role

  

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  

* Knowledge of Solventum™ 360 Encompass™ Professional products

* Electronic Medical Record implementation experience

* Ability to solve problems in a logical, methodical, and time efficient manner

* Must be self-starter with ability to analyze and critically think. Excellent problem solving and organizational skills.

* SQL, Windows Server and Networking

* Strong written/verbal communication skills and must be capable of maintaining superior customer relations in a fast-paced environment.

* Ability to quickly learn and apply new tools and technology

jobs.title: Client Success & Implementation Manager ($65-85k - Remote)
jobs.description:
Tired of watching great ideas never get implemented?

You've worked with business owners who have big goals, great ideas, and plenty of opportunities.

But there's always a problem. Nobody actually makes things happen.

Projects stall. Employees don't follow through. Systems never get implemented. The owner ends up doing everything themselves.

**You're the person who fixes that.**

You love taking something from idea to execution. You've built systems, managed people, solved operational problems, and made businesses run better.

And you're looking for an opportunity where you can take real ownership instead of just managing tasks.

**That's exactly who we're looking for.**

The Opportunity

At PestLaunch, we help pest control business owners grow more profitable, scalable companies.

We work directly with owners to improve their sales, hiring, operations, finances, and overall business performance.

Our founder develops the strategy.

**You'll own making it happen.**

We're hiring someone to take ownership of our entire client success and fulfillment experience.

Not just answering questions. Not just checking in. Not just updating project boards.

**Actually driving results.**

You'll work directly with business owners, lead implementation, coordinate our team, and make sure clients consistently move forward.

This is a chance to take ownership of a major function inside a growing company, work closely with the founder, and help build something you can be proud of.

What You'll Do

**Own Client Success**

* Build strong relationships with our clients.
* Lead onboarding, communication, and client accountability.
* Own client satisfaction, retention, and renewals.
* Understand each client's business, goals, and priorities.

**Drive Implementation**

* Turn our founder's strategies into actionable plans.
* Build and implement business systems, processes, and campaigns.
* Coordinate our team and clients to get work completed.
* Manage milestones, deadlines, and deliverables.
* Identify problems, solve them, and keep projects moving.

**Own Results**

* Ensure clients are making measurable progress every week.
* Verify that systems are implemented and actually being used.
* Keep our founder informed and prepared without needing to be chased.
* Improve our fulfillment processes as the company grows.

**You won't have to personally do everything. But you'll own making sure everything gets done.**

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for an **experienced operator who's also great with people.**

You probably have 4+ years of experience in business operations, implementation, project management, client success, or a similar role.

Ideally, you've worked directly with business owners, managed people, built systems, and taken projects from start to finish.

You're someone who:

* Takes initiative without waiting for instructions.
* Understands business operations and how to improve them.
* Can juggle multiple clients, projects, and deadlines.
* Communicates clearly and builds trust quickly.
* Holds people accountable without damaging relationships.
* Solves problems independently.
* Cares more about results than activity.

Experience in home services, field services, consulting, or coaching is a plus.

**Pest control experience is NOT required.**

This Probably Isn't for You If...

* You need someone telling you what to do every day.
* You're better at organizing tasks than getting them completed.
* You avoid difficult conversations or accountability.
* You wait for problems to be brought to your attention.
* You prefer a narrow role with limited responsibility.

We're looking for someone who wants ownership, not just another job.

What You Get

* **$65,000–$85,000 annual salary**, depending on experience.
* Full-time, remote position.
* Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Mountain Time.
* Direct access to the founder.
* Real autonomy and responsibility.
* The opportunity to build and eventually lead a growing client fulfillment operation.
* The satisfaction of helping real business owners build better companies.

How to Apply

Submit your résumé and a Loom video answering these 4 questions:

**1.** Tell us about you. Sell us on why you're the person for this role.

**2.** Tell us about a business system or process you personally built and implemented. What was the result?

**3.** We care about getting our clients results. Tell us about times when you got clients results.

**4.** Why does owning both client relationships AND implementation appeal to you?

**We're looking for someone who gets things done.**

Pay: $65,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Implementation Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
**About First Due**

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Enterprise Implementation Manager**

**Location**: Remote - US Only  
**Country**: United States  
**Department**: Professional Services  
**Reports To**: Sr Director, Enterprise Professional Services  
**Position Type**: Full-Time  
**Salary**: $100,000

### **Job Summary:**

The Implementation Manager, Enterprise owns end-to-end delivery of First Due's Enterprise implementation programs, the largest and most complex engagements in the US customer base. These are multi-module, multi-phase deployments for large fire and EMS agencies, involving computer-aided dispatch integrations, significant historical data migration from legacy records management systems, and layered stakeholder environments spanning command staff, information technology, the dispatch center, EMS, fire prevention, training, labor representation, and municipal government.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. The Implementation Manager coordinates a delivery team of Implementation Consultants and Technical Services resources, owns the program plan and the customer relationship, and is accountable for delivery quality, timeline integrity, and scope control across an assigned portfolio. The role is expected to run programs on formal project management discipline and to use AI tooling to remove routine work from delivery so that judgment, domain expertise, and executive presence carry the majority of the incumbent's time.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

### ***Program delivery and governance***

* Own delivery of an assigned portfolio of Enterprise programs from sales transition through configuration, integration, data migration, training, go-live, and Customer Success transition.
* Build and maintain program plans in Rocketlane, including critical path, workstream dependencies, module-level exit criteria, level-of-effort actuals, and risk and decision records.
* Sequence go-live events around agency operational readiness, and recover at-risk or stalled programs with a documented path to resolution or closure.
* Publish weekly program status covering schedule health against plan, open risks with named owners and dates, and decisions required.
* Own change control, and validate the sales transition ahead of kickoff so that scope, contract commitments, and go-live expectations are confirmed before the program starts.

### ***Stakeholder and executive engagement***

* Lead engagements involving large, multi-department stakeholder groups, commonly including the fire chief and command staff, information technology and cybersecurity, the dispatch center, EMS and medical direction, the training division, the fire prevention bureau, labor representation, and municipal government.
* Lead change adoption for constituencies that experience the platform differently, including shift-based personnel, represented workforces on scheduling and time capture, and volunteer or combination staffing models.

### ***AI-enabled delivery***

* Use First Due's AI tooling to remove routine delivery work, including status drafting, meeting summarization and action item capture, first-pass plan generation, and risk synthesis across concurrent workstreams.
* Apply AI-assisted analysis to program preparation, including legacy data assessment, first-pass migration field mapping, and agency-specific discovery sets, and act on Rocketlane forecasting signals to catch schedule slippage before a milestone is missed.
* Own the accuracy of any AI-assisted output that reaches an agency, and handle customer data within First Due's data handling standards.

### ***Commercial ownership and product partnership***

* Deliver against contracted services scope, hours, and fees, and bring a recommended commercial position to segment leadership when overrun risk appears.
* Draft and negotiate change orders in partnership with segment leadership, Sales, and the agency, including effort justification and revised schedule impact.
* Review statements of work and solicitation responses for delivery feasibility before commitment
* Surface field-driven enhancement requests to segment leadership and the Product organization, with reproducible detail and business impact.

### **Qualifications:**

* Seven or more years of customer-facing implementation, professional services, or program management experience in a SaaS environment, including ownership of multi-workstream programs with phased deployment across more than one department on the customer side.
* Strong public safety industry knowledge, with emphasis on fire service operations and EMS, including how agencies are organized, funded, and governed.
* Proven ability to lead large, multi-department stakeholder groups, including executive sponsors, technical staff, and represented or shift-based workforces.
* Formal project management discipline, including baselined scheduling, critical path management, risk and issue tracking, documented change control, and structured status reporting.
* Demonstrated use of AI tooling within a delivery or program management workflow, with the judgment to know where output is reliable and where human validation is required.
* Experience translating agency operational and regulatory requirements into software delivery scope.
* Excellent executive-level written and verbal communication, including the ability to deliver unwelcome information to senior customer stakeholders without damaging the relationship.
* Experience with Rocketlane or a comparable professional services delivery platform.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft products, including Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel).
* Ability to travel to customer sites, team events, and company offsites, up to 25 percent.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* PMP, or equivalent professional project or program management certification.
* Experience delivering programs to public sector or government customers, including procurement, security review, and compliance processes.
* Experience delivering within a formal program management or delivery governance function at a SaaS organization.
* Change management certification or formal change adoption methodology experience.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce, including account data hygiene and project handoff from sales.
* Direct hands-on experience with Rocketlane.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

**For US-based Roles**  
All applicants must be authorized to work for any US employer in the United States. Locality Media LLC is unable to sponsor or transition sponsorship ownership of employment visas at this time. Hiring is contingent upon candidates successfully passing a criminal background check. As part of the I-9 verification of authorization to work in the US, Locality Media participates in E-Verify.  
  
**Physical Demands and Work Environment**  
Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified employees and applicants to perform the essential functions as outlined above. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please reach out to people@firstdue.com.  
  
**Working at First Due**  
First Due offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package for eligible employees, including competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage, FSA/HSA, 401(k), flexible PTO, a fully remote workplace, a technology stipend, opportunities for advancement, and other benefits and perks that sets our team apart. Visit www.firstdue.com to learn more.  
  
If you are a resident of a state requiring wage transparency, please reach out to people@firstdue.com for a reasonable estimate of annual base compensation and any eligible incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered to successful candidates for roles may be higher or lower, based on non-discriminatory criteria including but not limited to relevant professional experience, geographic location, knowledge, skills, and abilities. *This range will be reviewed on a regular basis.*  
  
First Due is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status or class. We are committed to promoting an environment of respect, acceptance, diversity and inclusivity, and equal opportunity. Discrimination and harassment of any type in any form will not be tolerated.  
  
When you apply for a role at Locality Media, LLC d/b/a First Due, we collect personal information such as identifiers (e.g., name, email, phone number), professional and employment information, education information, and information you provide in your application materials. We use this information to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you, and manage our recruiting process. We may share this information with our service providers who assist with recruiting and background screening. We do not sell or share applicant personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. We retain applicant information in accordance with our data retention policies. California residents have rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the CPRA. For more information, please review our Candidate Privacy.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**

Strive Pharmacy is a personalized compounding pharmacy built on a simple conviction: medicine should fit the patient, not the other way around. We started Strive because we believed the pharmaceutical industry was overdue for a more human approach—one that prioritizes individualized care, clinical nuance, and genuine partnership with patients and providers.

Compounding gives us the tools to do that. Every formulation we prepare is built to the specific needs of a specific person, and every interaction we have is guided by that same commitment to personalized care.

We're growing, and we're looking for people who share that conviction. If you're ready to be part of a pharmacy that takes the work seriously and the people even more seriously, we'd like to meet you.

**Mission:**

Strive exists to disrupt an industry long overdue for a more personal approach to care. We put the human element at the center of everything: every formulation, every patient interaction, every provider partnership. We're not just a compounding pharmacy. We're a team on a mission to change what personalized healthcare looks and feels like.

**Position Type:** Remote, Full time

**Position Overview:**

We are looking for a detailed-oriented and proactive Client Implementation Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be the primary guide for new clients during their onboarding journey, ensuring a seamless transition from onboarding to active product usage. You will oversee technical setup, workflow configuration, project timelines, and user training.

The ideal candidate excels at project management, possesses a solid technical aptitude, and brings exceptional communication skills to build trust and deliver value to our clients from day one.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Onboarding:
  + Project Delivery: Lead end-to-end client onboarding and technical implementations, driving projects to completion within defined timeframes and scope.
  + Milestone Tracking: Monitor go-live milestones, proactively identify risks or bottlenecks, and implement solutions to keep timelines on track.
* Technical Configuration & System Integration:
  + System Setup: Configure software/platform settings, user accounts, and workflows based on client specifications and requirements.
  + Assist with setting up products and medication templates in EMR
  + Set up user accounts for HubSpot clarifications
  + Configure web hooks via LifeFile if no integration is needed
  + Hand off partners to the Client Solutions team if an API integration is identified
* Data Migration & Support:
  + Assist clients with data mapping, import/export tasks, and initial data validation.
* Troubleshooting:
  + Diagnose and resolve technical implementation issues independently or partner with Client Solutions technical support
* Client Enablement & Relationship Management:
  + Training Delivery:
    - Conduct virtual live training sessions for admin users and end-users to drive product adoption.
  + Consultative Guidance:
    - Advise clients on best practices for prescribing to maximize compounded prescription accuracy
  + Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    - Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success Manager (CSM) teams to ensure seamless handoffs and continuous client satisfaction.
  + Prescription Success:
    - Monitor prescriptions for clinical and formatting accuracy and perform outreach when issues are identified. Monitoring period will be from first prescription until activation of account (10th prescription)

**Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum 2 years experience as a registered pharmacy technician
* Holds a PTCB certification
* Has implementation experience OR strong understanding of EMR platforms  
  Strong technical writing skills (SOPs, product changes, client documentation)
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills - comfortable with both technical teams and client stakeholders

**Work Environment:**

This position is primarily based in a remote work environment. The role requires regular periods of sitting, standing, and computer use, with occasional lifting as needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

**Join Us in Making an Impact:**

At Strive, the work is real and the impact is direct. Every role here contributes to a patient experience that's more personal, more attentive, and more human than what most people have come to expect from a pharmacy. Apply today and help us raise the bar.

**Benefits/ Perks:**
